about_the_game:
Wizard's Oblation is a cooperative multiplayer game about searching for magical artifacts in procedurally generated worlds.

Using a lever in the starting zone, players open a portal to a new, randomly generated level. Each level is scattered with items — artifacts that contain unique spells. These spells can be used either for personal benefit or to support the team.

The main objective is to collect a required number of items within a limited number of portal activations.

After several activations, a shop appears, allowing players to trade found items for coins. Each coin counts as one item, reducing the quota. This gives players flexibility in how they use their resources:

  • Use an item directly to cast its spell. The item is destroyed in the process.

  • Sacrifice the item by throwing it into the pit in the starting zone. This reduces the quota by 1 and provides a spell orb, which allows repeated use of the extracted spell at the cost of mana.

  • Sell the item in the shop for coins. Coins also reduce the quota (1 coin = 1 item) but provide nothing in return.

Throughout the levels, hostile creatures roam — and they, too, can use magic against the players.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes surreal and grotesque enemy designs, a tense atmosphere, and spells that can kill both player characters and enemies.
